name: Stage 23:2: Harpsundsvägen to Hälleforsnäs
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 23:2, Harpsundsvägen to Hälleforsnäs.
utilities: Harpsundsvägen is the official start but has no official parking and no verified toilet, water, shelter, shop, or easy transit at the road junction. Plan a drop-off, continue from stage 23:1, or start/end from Hälleforsnäs instead.

Hälleforsnäs is the reliable service end: station access via the 22:1 connector, nearby parking at Edströmsvallen/Turistbyrån, Coop, restaurants/cafes, tourist information, Bruksdammen facilities, and lodging options. Verify current opening hours before depending on food or indoor toilets.

Hedsjön is the only confirmed overnight/rest node on the stage, with shelter, fireplace/grill context, a nearby toilet, and natural lake water. The toilet is reported 100-200 m north/toward Hälleforsnäs rather than directly beside the shelter.
waterSources: The only official/mapped water point is the spring north of Hedsjön at about 4.5 km. OSM tags it as drinking water and official sources list it as a spring, but Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee flow or tested potable quality; treat/filter/boil if unsure.
Hedsjön lake water is natural/untested. Hiker reports used it only after filtering, and lake access near the shelter is not a prepared beach or jetty.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.
Official distance is 10 km. OSM relation 9636668 is the correct Stage 23:2 relation and measures around 10.3 km; Äventyrligare/AllTrails variants around 10.1-10.3 km are normal geometry differences.

Draw Stage 23:2 from Harpsundsvägen to the shared Hälleforsnäs/Bruksdammen stage junction west of Bruksdammen. Do not include Hälleforsnäs station in the core line; station access belongs to connector 22:1 and Bruksslingan access.
Stage 23:2 is the second half of the Flen-Hälleforsnäs connector and hands off from Stage 23:1 at Harpsundsvägen. At Hälleforsnäs it meets stages 22 and 23 around the Bruksdammen junction.

Official Sörmlandsleden page showed no current fault reports during the 2026-04-27 research pass. A 2022 hiker report described a rough/unclear logged section shortly after Harpsundsvägen and overgrown stretches near/north of Hedsjön; treat that as historical caution unless a newer report confirms it.

Route character is a short road walk toward Harpsund, forest path, crossings of Viks å, Hedsjön viewpoint/shelter, older overgrown farmland around Rösjötorp, old forest, charcoal-kiln remains, and final approach to the Bruksdammen/Hälleforsnäs junction.

Do not promote Harpsund as an easy side trip to see Harpsundsekan. Harpsund is a protected object: the point/udde is closed, protected shoreline/water areas are signed, visitor parking is limited and can close, and posted access, photography, depiction or measurement restrictions must be respected.

No designated tent site was verified on 23:2. Hedsjön shelter is first-come/shared and not bookable; discreet one-night tenting may be possible under allemansrätten where it does not disturb or damage, but check local signs and avoid farmland, private areas and any protected Harpsund zones.

Use established fire/grill places only, bring/expect no supplied firewood, pack out trash, and check current fire-ban status. No stage-specific nature reserve rule page was confirmed for Hedsjön/23:2 during this pass.

Hedsjön is not a municipal sampled bathing place; reports describe rocky/vegetated access rather than a prepared beach. Treat lake water and Viks å as natural water only, and avoid wading/swimming where footing or flow is uncertain.

facilities.name: Harpsundsvägen stage start, no parking
facilities.description: Official 23:2 start. Sörmlandsleden explicitly says no parking here; no toilet, tap, shelter, or reliable transit was verified at the road junction.

facilities.name: Harpsund protected-object caveat
facilities.description: Harpsund is a protected object. Access inside the protected area is prohibited; follow signs, fences and any posted photography/depiction/measurement restrictions. The point/udde is closed and visitor parking may close.

facilities.name: Harpsundsvägen clear-cut/marking historical caution
facilities.description: Historical 2022 hiker report described a rough, unclear clear-cut section shortly after the road-walk start, with old markings, high grass, branches and holes. Official page currently lists no faults, so treat this as stale-but-useful caution.

facilities.name: Viks å crossings
facilities.description: Route crosses Viks å in a couple of places. Natural stream context only, not a verified drinking-water source; expect variable wet footing or flow after rain.

facilities.name: Hedsjön shelter
facilities.description: Official shelter after about 4 km on the northeast side of Hedsjön. Free, shared, first-come, not bookable, with no guaranteed firewood or bins; 2022 hiker report found it weather-sturdy during heavy rain/wind.

facilities.name: Hedsjön shelter fireplace
facilities.description: Fire/grill context at the shelter area, supported by Sörmlandsleden's general shelter guidance and hiker reports rather than a separately surveyed official fireplace coordinate. Use only if current fire-ban status allows it.

facilities.name: Hedsjön toilet, approximate
facilities.description: Official sources confirm a toilet near Hedsjön, but exact coordinate was not published. Hiker/source comments place it roughly 100-200 m north/toward Hälleforsnäs from the shelter and note it can be easy to miss.

facilities.name: Hedsjön lake water
facilities.description: Natural lake water near the shelter; not a potable refill. Hiker reports filtered it, and shoreline access is rocky/vegetated rather than a prepared beach or municipal sampled bathing place.

facilities.name: Spring north of Hedsjön
facilities.description: Only official/mapped water point on this stage, about 4.5 km from the start and about 1 km after Hedsjön. Treat/filter/boil if unsure; no recent source verifies year-round flow or tested potable quality.

facilities.name: Rösjötorp and charcoal remains
facilities.description: Approximate cultural-history corridor with old farmland, Rösjötorp ruin, a stone-lined pit likely connected to flax processing, charcoal-kiln bottoms, and charcoal-burner hut remains. Look but do not disturb.

facilities.name: Hälleforsnäs / Bruksdammen trail junction
facilities.description: Official end area west of Bruksdammen where stages 22, 23, and 23:2 meet. Not the railway station; use connector 22:1 for rail access.

facilities.name: Bruksdammen nearby shelter/fireplace
facilities.description: Nearby Bruksslingan/Bruksdammen shelter and grill context at the Hälleforsnäs end; useful endpoint service, not mid-stage.

facilities.name: Bruksdammen accessible toilet
facilities.description: Accessible toilet near Bruksdammen/Bruksslingan; official Bruksslingan information notes winter closure.

facilities.name: Bruksdammen / Edströmsvallen parking access
facilities.description: Use Edströmsvallen or Turistbyrån/Bruket parking for the Hälleforsnäs end; do not assume parking at the exact stage junction.

facilities.name: Hälleforsnäs station connector
facilities.description: Rail/bus access via the official 22:1 connector, about 1.5 km from the station to Edströmsvallen/Bruksdammen.

facilities.name: Coop Hälleforsnäs
facilities.description: Grocery/resupply in Hälleforsnäs near the service end. Check current opening hours and payment status.

facilities.name: Bruket / Hälleforsnäs food and visitor services
facilities.description: Tourist information, restaurants/cafes, bakery, dairy/delicatessen context around Bruket. Opening hours vary.

facilities.name: Bäckstugan B&B
facilities.description: Trail-near Hälleforsnäs lodging with kitchen, WC/shower, and limited beds; coordinate approximate and availability must be checked.
